programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Ketika kehilangan mengubah segalanya, Luna harus bangkit, menemukan kembali harapannya dan menghadapi pertemuan yang tak pernah ia duga. Akankah pertemuan itu menjadi awal dari kebahagiaan atau justru membawa luka yang lebih besar?

programme.title: Terikat Janji
programme.desc: kisah cinta yang rumit, penuh intrik, dan pengkhianatan yang mengguncang, Terikat Janji

programme.title: Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Satu pengkhianatan mengubah hidup selamanya, 5 tahun mendekam di penjara. Sekarang dia kembali dengan identitas baru, namun kebenaran tak mudah digenggam.

programme.title: Sopir Eneng Dunia Akhirat

programme.title: Pay Later S1 E1
programme.desc: Penunjukan Tika sebagai pegawai tetap di kantor pajak dibatalkan karena adanya pengkhianatan, dan posisi tersebut diberikan kepada Yuli, temannya. programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Joe & Robot Kopi S1 E6
programme.desc: Clara dan lbu Joe berangkat bersama seorang petugas polisi menuju persembunyian Duo Kepo. Tapi saat tiba di lokasi, rumah terbengkalai itu sudah kosong, Polisi mempertanyakan informasi lokasi dari Clara. Rupanya Duo Kepo sudah mengetahui HP Joe yang mengirimkan pesan sos dan melakukan Evakuasi dengan menggunakan sebuah gerobak yang melewati Clara dan Polisi.

programme.title: IPA & IPS S1 E9

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Penyanyi Qing Qing dan arsitek Tang Peng Nan adalah pasangan serasi. Ia mengorbankan dirinya untuk membantu Peng Nan pada saat keluarganya mengalami kesulitan. Namun, mereka putus karena kesalahpahaman.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: Qiao Miao hampir membunuh bandit yang baru saja ia temui, tapi ia tertarik dengan kecantikannya dan dengan cepat keduanya jatuh cinta. Kemudian, mereka terlibat dalam perseteruan antara pemilik senjata nan unik.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Beberapa bintang wanita terbesar Shaw Brothers di tahun 1970-an tampil bersama dalam kisah tentang cinta dan orangtua yang terlampau ikut campur. Dibintangi oleh Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei dan Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: Chou Lian Huan sangat ahli dalam pertarungan tinju di Shanghai. Demi menyenangkan wanita bernama Chen Ju Fang, ia rela mengorbankan segalanya dan bertarung melawan putra seorang pemimpin geng di Shanghai.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: Seorang istri yang sakit parah bekerjasama dengan asisten rumah tangganya untuk membunuh sang suami yang kasar. Namun, hal ini menyebabkan serangkaian kejadian mengerikan.

programme.title: The Bells Of Death
programme.desc: Berkisah tentang perjalanan hidup seorang pria untuk belajar pedang, lalu melaksanakan balas dendamnya pada 3 pria yang telah membunuh keluarganya dan menculik adiknya.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan adalah seorang penjudi kambuhan. Ia menjadikan istrinya sebagai uang muka atas utangnya. Ia pun menyesal dan memutuskan untuk bunuh diri, namun niatnya dihentikan oleh kemunculan sesosok hantu cantik.

programme.title: Vengeance Is A Golden Blade
programme.desc: Istri Pengiring Master Li berselingkuh dengan saingannya yang bernama Long, ia berencana untuk mencuri Pedang Emas Li dan membunuhnya serta putrinya yang masih kecil.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu berperan sebagai putra seorang kepala polisi, yang jatuh cinta pada seorang penari nan seksi. Saat sang gadis diperkosa, ia bersumpah untuk menentang ayahnya dan membalas dendam!

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, murid klan Huashan, ditugaskan untuk mencari penerus 'The Proud One'. Ling merasa Ying adalah orang yang tepat, tetapi ia menemukan bahwa Ying adalah putri dari pemimpin klan jahat.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, murid klan Huashan, ditugaskan untuk mencari penerus 'The Proud One'. Ling merasa Ying adalah orang yang tepat, tetapi ia menemukan bahwa Ying adalah putri dari pemimpin klan jahat.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pencinta wanita kaya menulis buku harian tentang petualangan asmaranya, tetapi semua wanita yang pernah diselingkuhinya telah dibunuh.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Ketika Kaisar dibunuh dan takhtanya dirampas oleh Lord 9, kedua pangeran yang masih bayi dipercayakan dalam perawatan tiga biksu Shaolin dan sang perdana menteri.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: Seorang bangsawan yang kehilangan keterampilan kung fu meminta keponakan dan tunangannya untuk mengawal emas ke ibukota. Di perjalanan, mereka bertemu seorang ksatria misterius dan mencegah para bandit mencuri emas.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang menulis dan menyutradarai Tales of Larceny, kisah tentang tipu muslihat dan permainan licik di era panglima perang Tiongkok yang korup, dibintangi aktor-aktor karakter terbaik dari Shaw Brothers.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: Guo Jing bertemu Huang Rong dan mereka jatuh cinta. Di saat yang sama, Ouyang Ke melamar Huang Rong, sehingga ayah Huang mengatur sebuah duel untuk kedua pria tersebut.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Ahli film laga Chang Cheh menceritakan kisah tentang Chin Feng yang bertemu dengan gadis cantik bernama Ting Hung saat tengah melarikan diri, setelah ia tak sengaja membunuh seorang pengganggu yang sombong.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: Film antologi kung fu tentang seorang pria yang mempermalukan dirinya sendiri, seorang PSK yang jatuh cinta dengan seorang jenderal dan sekelompok bandit yang berencana menyelamatkan seorang teman dari eksekusi.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: Idola tahun '70-an, Hsing Hui dan Yon Fan, membintangi film horor yang bercerita tentang pengusaha muda yang menikahi wanita muda nan cantik tanpa menyadari jika sang gadis dirasuki oleh iblis.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: Dalam film yang merangkai misteri dan ketegangan dengan aksi kung fu ini, seorang ahli kung fu membalas dendam setelah mendekam selama 15 tahun di penjara. Ia mampu bertahan menghadapi ujian di sepanjang hidupnya!

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David jatuh cinta pada Dan Feng dan menikahinya. Saudari David yang bernama Mona jatuh cinta dengan sahabatnya, Han Ming. Karena cemburu, Mona berbohong tentang perselingkuhan antara Han Ming dan Dan Feng.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: Sang Pendekar Tangkas terlibat dalam jalinan percintaan, intrik kekuasaan, dan pertarungan sembari melindungi bayi pewaris takhta dalam kisah tentang para pendekar pemberani, keksatriaan, dan wanita-wanita cantik ini.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: Pada masa kemunduran Dinasti Ching, putra dari hakim lokal membunuh seorang pedagang keliling dan memperkosa istrinya. Sang istri dijebak atas pembunuhan suaminya oleh sang pemerkosa.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: David Chiang berperan sebagai Pangeran ke-13, seorang petarung muda yang perkasa. Status istimewa yang ia miliki menimbulkan kecemburuan dan perseteruan keluarga yang mengerikan.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Seorang panglima perang Tiongkok menyewa seorang tukang sihir untuk membantunya mengesankan selirnya yang menolak.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda bertemu dengan seorang novelis di sebuah bar dan langsung jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, ternyata ia malah terperangkap ke dalam jebakan yang direkayasa oleh si novelis dan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei mengalami gangguan pascatrauma usai kematian istrinya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Amy yang bekerja di perusahaan teknologi VR dan diundang untuk menguji produk baru. Ia pun menjadi petarung VR perusahaan itu.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: Raja Naga dikunci dalam segel oleh Tuan Naga selama 500 tahun, dan putri sang Raja harus kembali ke masa lalu guna membunuh Tuan Naga saat mengetahui bahwa keduanya adalah teman dekat di masa lalu.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: Rencana penguburan ulang seorang tetua kota berubah menjadi bencana ketika jenazah tersebut bangkit kembali menjadi vampir haus darah yang melompat-lompat, mengincar semua orang yang bertanggung jawab menggali kuburan tersebut. Seorang Pendeta Tao dan dua muridnya berusaha menghentikan teror tersebut.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Pergantian rezim di Leka memicu konflik di dunia hitam & putih. Polisi mengirim Zheng Zha menyusup ke geng Song Bang, tanpa tahu pihak lain sudah siap membalas dendam.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing menciptakan genre film perjudian hampir sendirian, dan dalam salah satu film laris awalnya, Shih Hsien memimpin pemeran bintang dalam kisah tentang mata-mata, taipan, dan gadis cantik.

programme.title: Lifeline (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Berlatar tiga tahun setelah Dragon Inn, pemilik penginapan Jade telah menghilang dan sebuah penginapan baru telah bangkit dari reruntuhan - penginapan yang dikelola oleh para perampok yang menyamar sebagai warga negara yang taat hukum, yang berharap untuk menggali kota hilang yang legendaris yang terkubur di gurun.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. B, yang memiliki nama lengkap Benjamin Barker, adalah seorang pegawai kantoran yang menjalani kehidupan monoton. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah insiden aneh di laboratorium ilmiah tempat temannya bekerja, Mr. B terpapar dengan zat misterius yang memberinya kemampuan untuk terbang. Awalnya, dia merasa bingung dan takut, tetapi segera dia mulai mengeksplorasi kekuatan barunya dengan penuh semangat.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: Seorang penulis yang putus asa menjalin persahabatan yang tidak terduga dengan seorang remaja dari Long Island.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detektif Lin membentuk unit khusus untuk menangkap perampok motor dan sindikat di balik aksi pencurian di Foshan usai istrinya yang hamil ditabrak oleh perampok motor.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing dan kakaknya, Ma Tai Chueng, tiba di Shanghai untuk mencari peruntungan. Berteman dengan seorang gangster berkuasa, ia diberi klub malam sebagai imbalan atas penyelamatan nyawa Tam Sei. Sayangnya, seorang gangster lain juga menginginkan wilayah tersebut.

Macao: From Yearning..., Ep 7
programme.desc: Film dokumenter ini menyoroti proyek-proyek konstruksi di Tiongkok yang berfokus pada keberlanjutan, inovasi, dan teknologi

programme.title: Built On Sand And Sea, Ep 4
programme.desc: Dunhuang dan Venesia dua tempat yang sangat berbeda, terpisah ribuan mil! Mungkinkah perjalanan yang membawa kita ke jantung gurun Gobi yang gersang dan ke dasar laguna Venesia yang asin dapat memberikan jawabannya?

Shijiahe, Ep 1

programme.title: Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink : PL Moments
programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments from his Premier League career.

programme.title: Hero Dog: The Journey Home
programme.desc: Terpisah dari keluarga akibat sebuah kejadian yang tak terduga, seekor anjing setia berjuang menempuh perjalanan panjang untuk menemukan jalan pulang. Di tengah medan yang penuh tantangan, ia menghadapi berbagai bahaya, bertemu orang-orang yang membantunya, serta menunjukkan keberanian dan kesetiaan yang luar biasa. Hero Dog: The Journey Home menghadirkan kisah petualangan keluarga yang hangat tentang arti persahabatan, harapan, dan ikatan istimewa antara manusia dan sahabat berkaki empatnya.

programme.title: Cowboy And Indiana
programme.desc: Seorang juara penunggang banteng berjuang melawan kecanduan.

programme.title: Mike Says Goodbye

programme.title: Outlawed

programme.title: My Fatal Social Following
programme.desc: Julia, seorang remaja yang kesepian dan dikucilkan, sedang berusaha menerima kenyataan hilangnya sahabatnya ketika dia menemukan sebuah akun media sosial misterius bernama 'The Family'.

programme.title: 24 Hours With Megan Thee...
programme.desc: Mengabadikan perjalanan Megan Thee Stallion menuju ketenaran, mengarungi ketenaran, duka, dan kesuksesan. Film ini menawarkan akses tak tertandingi kepada sang seniman multifaset, mengungkap momen-momen rentannya, dan memungkinkan kita bertemu dengan Megan Pete yang sesungguhnya di balik persona tersebut.

programme.title: Tapped Out

Ketika Tolly yang berusia 13 tahun menyadari bahwa ia dapat secara misterius berpindah di antara keduanya, ia memulai petualangan yang mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang terkubur selama beberapa generasi.

programme.title: Bad Karma
programme.desc: Bad Karma mengisahkan Jack Malloy, seorang mantan kriminal yang memutuskan meninggalkan kehidupan kejahatan setelah mengalami pengalaman yang mengubah hidupnya. Namun ketenangan yang ia bangun terusik ketika mantan rekannya, Drake, bebas dari penjara dan memaksanya bergabung dalam sebuah aksi terakhir. Di tengah ancaman, pengkhianatan, dan upaya balas dendam, Jack harus memilih antara kembali ke dunia lamanya atau mempertahankan kehidupan baru yang telah diperjuangkannya.

programme.title: 24 Hours With Megan Thee...
programme.desc: Mengabadikan perjalanan Megan Thee Stallion menuju ketenaran, mengarungi ketenaran, duka, dan kesuksesan. Film ini menawarkan akses tak tertandingi kepada sang seniman multifaset, mengungkap momen-momen rentannya, dan memungkinkan kita bertemu dengan Megan Pete yang sesungguhnya di balik persona tersebut.

programme.title: Damascena_ The Transition
programme.desc: Damascena: The Transition mengisahkan perjalanan sebuah keluarga yang harus menghadapi perubahan besar dalam hidup mereka. Berbagai peristiwa tak terduga memunculkan kembali konflik lama, perbedaan pandangan, serta pencarian jati diri yang menguji hubungan antarsesama anggota keluarga. Seiring waktu, mereka belajar bahwa empati, komunikasi, dan penerimaan menjadi kunci untuk menyembuhkan luka masa lalu dan melangkah menuju masa depan. Film drama ini menyajikan kisah yang hangat dan reflektif tentang perubahan, rekonsiliasi, serta kuatnya ikatan keluarga.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: Seorang penipu yang berusaha naik dari pekerja karnaval rendahan menjadi medium paranormal terkenal harus adu kecerdikan dengan seorang psikolog yang bertekad membongkar tipu dayanya.

programme.title: The Gridiron
programme.desc: Berdasarkan kisah nyata tahun 1985. Derek adalah seorang pemimpi dan pecundang. Seberapa keras pun dia berusaha, dia selalu gagal dalam segala hal yang dicobanya. Bertekad untuk menunjukkan kepada dunia bahwa dia bisa sukses dalam sesuatu, dia membentuk tim American Football di negara yang didominasi oleh sepak bola Amerika, rugby, kriket, dan ikan & kentang goreng. Keinginannya untuk sukses menguasai hidupnya dan dia buta untuk melihat bahwa kesuksesannya akan membuatnya kehilangan segalanya.

Namun kemudian terjadi dugaan pembunuhan yang diikuti oleh upaya pembunuhan lainnya. Masalah-masalah lain pun muncul. Ia pun melakukan penyelidikan.

Semakin banyak ramalan yang terbukti benar, Jimmy mulai terjebak dalam ketakutan, paranoia, dan obsesi untuk menghindari takdirnya. Upayanya mengubah masa depan justru membawanya pada serangkaian peristiwa menegangkan yang menguji kewarasannya serta hubungannya dengan orang-orang di sekitarnya.

programme.title: Laugh Riot: The Misadventure
programme.desc: Frankie Blair Presents: Laugh Riot adalah serial komedi stand-up yang dinamis dan menghibur, menampilkan beragam komedian dengan gaya humor yang unik. Dipandu oleh Tahir Moore dan diproduseri oleh Frankie Blair, acara berenergi tinggi ini menghadirkan tawa segar sekaligus merayakan talenta-talenta berbakat yang selama ini kurang mendapat sorotan.

programme.title: Iron Fist: Rebellion

programme.title: The Pig Farmer
programme.desc: Investigasi pemenang penghargaan atas kejahatan Robert Pickton. Film dokumenter ini mengeksplorasi mengapa butuh bertahun-tahun untuk menangkap dan menghukum pembunuh berantai paling produktif di Kanada. Pengungkapan yang meresahkan tentang siapa yang tahu apa, dan kapan.

programme.title: Gunfight At Dry River
programme.desc: Perbatasan AS-Meksiko pada tahun 1888. Di Dry River, sebuah kota gurun yang dilanda kekeringan, janji emas akan membawa harapan, cinta, dan kematian dalam ukuran yang sama.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ayahnya, Tim Webber kembali ke desa asalnya di Sommerset dan menemukan sesuatu nan mengerikan yang mengganggu ketenangan desanya.

programme.title: Holy Ghost People
programme.desc: Demi menemukan saudarinya, seorang wanita muda menyewa seorang mantan Marinir pecandu alkohol untuk membantunya menyusup ke Gereja Pantekosta One Accord.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
programme.desc: Film ini mengikuti perjalanan seorang pria yang memburu geng saudaranya di seluruh wilayah barat Amerika untuk menghentikan aksi brutal mereka.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: Setelah mengamati hasil pemindaian CAT abnormal yang sangat familiar pada seorang gadis berusia 13 tahun, ahli radiologi Nina Evanko berjuang untuk menemukan sumber gangguan tidur yang dialami gadis muda itu. Apa yang ia temukan lebih gelap dan aneh dari yang dapat ia bayangkan.

programme.title: American Rider
programme.desc: Dua pengendara sepeda motor berangkat dari LA menuju New Orleans melalui daerah terbuka dan padang gurun, dan di sepanjang jalan mereka bertemu dengan seorang pria yang menjembatani kesenjangan budaya tandingan yang sebelumnya tidak mereka ketahui.

programme.title: Revival
programme.desc: Suatu hari yang ajaib di pedesaan Wisconsin, orang-orang mati bangkit dari kubur mereka, namun tampak dan berperilaku tidak berubah. Kini, giliran Petugas dan seorang ibu tunggal, Dana Cypress, untuk memecahkan kasus pembunuhan di mana semua orang, hidup atau mati, menjadi tersangka.

programme.title: Beneath Us
programme.desc: Ideologi Impian Amerika menjadi mimpi buruk bagi sekelompok pekerja harian ilegal yang dipekerjakan oleh pasangan kaya raya.

programme.title: Murder Syndicate
programme.desc: Ketika matriark dari sebuah keluarga pembunuh bayaran jatuh sakit, ketiga anaknya dan pacarnya yang lebih muda saling berebut untuk mengambil alih kerajaan bisnisnya.

programme.title: Murder Syndicate
programme.desc: Ketika matriark dari sebuah keluarga pembunuh bayaran jatuh sakit, ketiga anaknya dan pacarnya yang lebih muda saling berebut untuk mengambil alih kerajaan bisnisnya.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: Kesempatan terakhir seorang komedian veteran untuk menjadi bintang membawanya ke jalan bersama seorang komedian muda yang mengungkap masa lalu yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu adalah seorang pemuda ambisius yang bermimpi menjadi penari hip-hop profesional. Kala sang ayah melarangnya, ia malah memutuskan untuk menjadikan tarian sebagai jalan hidupnya.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: Seorang kurir khusus ditugaskan untuk mengirim sebuah kotak misterius ke dunia pembunuh bayaran nan berbahaya.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Seorang perawat asal Inggris lolos dari serangan di pos terdepan. Saat ia diburu oleh kelompok yang dipimpin Jerman, ia memulai perjalanan epik demi menyelamatkan pos terdekat dengan bantuan dari pejuang setempat.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tersiksa oleh masa lalunya, seorang petugas kebersihan bernama Clean mencoba menjalani kehidupan yang tenang. Tak lama kemudian, ia dipaksa untuk berdamai dengan kekerasan masa lalunya.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Mengikuti seekor anjing yang merupakan ahli melarikan diri, yang harus bekerja sama dengan teman-teman anak anjingnya untuk mencegah blok mereka dirampok.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: Seorang detektif swasta harus mengungkap pembunuhan pamannya sambil menjaga rahasia bahwa dia adalah keturunan manusia serigala.

programme.title: The Lurking Fear
programme.desc: Ketika kru TV merekam sebuah reality show di sebuah rumah sakit jiwa yang terbengkalai, mereka bertemu dengan gerombolan iblis, yang menyebabkan pertarungan berdarah untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Berlatar saat Perang Dunia II, sekelompok tentara Angkatan Darat Amerika dikirim dalam misi rahasia untuk menemukan komandan mereka yang hilang.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre

programme.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger: Built...
programme.desc: Dari awal kehidupannya yang sederhana di kota kecil Thal, Arnold Schwarzenegger berhasil menjelma menjadi salah satu sosok paling ikonik dan berpengaruh dalam sejarah Hollywood. Ia memulai karier sebagai seorang binaragawan yang berdedikasi, membentuk bukan hanya fisiknya, tetapi juga masa depannya. Berbekal tekad yang luar biasa, Arnold beralih dari dunia binaraga ke industri perfilman dan memikat penonton dengan kharisma serta peran-perannya yang tak terlupakan. Namun, ambisinya tidak berhenti di sana. Ia kemudian terjun ke dunia politik, membuktikan kemampuan dan semangatnya untuk terus berkembang. Inilah kisah luar biasa, penuh tantangan dan keberhasilan, dari legenda film laga Arnold Schwarzenegger.

programme.title: Whitney: Behind The Voice
programme.desc: Sebuah perjalanan dahsyat ke dalam kebangkitan Whitney Houston yang meroket - dari akar musik gospelnya hingga menjadi superstar global - mengungkap hubungan yang rumit, perjuangan yang menghantui melawan kecanduan, dan kejatuhan yang memilukan dari suara yang dulunya tak tergoyahkan, sebelum akhirnya meninggal dunia.

programme.title: Decoding Animal Culture, Ep 1
programme.desc: Sebagaimana manusia, hewan juga saling berbagi pengetahuan dan tradisi yang mereka pelajari satu sama lain, lalu mewariskannya dari generasi ke generasi. Untuk pertama kalinya, para ilmuwan serta pakar ekologi dan etologi sepakat bahwa budaya hewan merupakan bentuk pewarisan kedua selain genetika. Dalam serial dokumenter tiga bagian ini, kita akan mengamati lebih dekat berbagai perilaku menakjubkan di alam liar dan menemukan betapa luasnya budaya yang berkembang di berbagai populasi hewan. Dokumenter ini mengungkap beragam keterampilan dan kebiasaan yang menyatukan individu-individu dalam kelompok mereka. Saatnya menjelajahi kehidupan sosial hewan di seluruh dunia dengan sudut pandang baru, menyingkap kemampuan luar biasa dan kekayaan budaya yang selama ini luput dari perhatian kita. Saksikan bagaimana ternyata manusia memiliki lebih banyak kesamaan dengan dunia hewan daripada yang kita bayangkan.

programme.title: Poyo Show

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Pororo Season 7
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Tayo The Little Bus
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: Tayo Creator Clip
programme.desc: Saat Tayo dan teman-temannya menjalani hari, lihatlah teman-teman baru yang mereka temui.

programme.title: Poyo Poyo Story Vending Machine
programme.desc: Mesin penjual cerita memompa semua jenis cerita menyenangkan dari Pororo. Tayo dan Titipo!

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.title: Morphle - English Season 7
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan Mila yang berusia 5 tahun dan hewan peliharaan ajaibnya Morphle, yang dapat berubah menjadi apa pun yang diimpikan Mila!

programme.title: Poyo Poyo Video Calls
programme.desc: Halo? Hai Pororo! Panggilan video antara Pororo dan Tayo! Apa yang akan dibicarakan Pororo dan Tayo hari ini? Haruskah kita memanggil Pororo dan Tayo?

programme.title: Po-Stagram
programme.desc: Gambar apa yang akan diposkan Pororo dan teman-temannya di Postagram? Lihat semua foto dan lihat kembali semua kenangan indah bersama.

programme.title: Cocomelon English
programme.desc: Pelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, dan lainnya dengan JJ dalam serial musik yang menghadirkan saat-saat menyenangkan dengan sajak anak-anak untuk seluruh keluarga

programme.title: Poyo Show
programme.desc: Rasakan kisah Pororo, Tayo dan Tittipo! Hari ini, apa yang akan terjadi pada teman-teman kita?

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. Setelah menetas, kedua saudara ini harus kreatif untuk menyembunyikan teman-teman baru mereka—lagipula, tidak ada yang tahu keberadaan makhluk-makhluk energik ini, dan predator bisa saja mengintai di setiap sudut.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: Seorang pria yang menjadi tersangka kasus pembunuhan mencari bantuan dari seorang pengacara untuk membuktikan bahwa ia tidak bersalah. Saat mereka mulai mengumpulkan bukti-bukti, kebenaran pun perlahan terkuak.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: The Boys
programme.desc: Sebuah cerita tentang pemimpin tim investigasi, Hwang Joon-cheol, yang bertugas menyelidiki anak laki-laki yang dicurigai melakukan perampokan di supermarket kota setempat, 'Woori Super'.

programme.title: Salmokji: Whispering Water (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Sebuah kejadian terjadi ketika tim produksi pergi ke sebuah waduk untuk memperbarui tampilan jalan. Di sana, mereka merekam sosok misterius yang tidak dikenal dan menemukan sesuatu di dalam air yang gelap dan dalam.

programme.title: Single In Seoul
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho adalah seorang pemengaruh terkenal yang mengagungkan kehidupan lajang. Hyeon-Jin adalah seorang editor yang sangat ingin menemukan pasangan. Keduanya bertemu saat bekerja bersama untuk sebuah buku.

programme.title: The Childe
programme.desc: Marco, seorang petinju yang lahir dari ayah Korea dan ibu Filipina. Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.

programme.title: War Of The Arrows (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Berlatar saat invasi Manchu ke-dua di Korea, Nam Yi, yang merupakan seorang pemanah terbaik di Korea, melawan Dinasti Qing untuk menyelamatkan adik perempuannya, Ja In, yang akan diperbudak oleh penduduk Manchuria.

programme.title: Once Again
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang cinta dan keluarga yang berlatar belakang Keluarga Song, yang tak pernah memiliki hari yang tenang.

programme.title: The Ultimate Duo
programme.desc: Seorang detektif senior yang sering membuat masalah dan detektif pemula kaya raya melakukan perjalanan dinas ke Seoul untuk menyelidiki kembali kasus pembunuhan misterius.

programme.title: Cadaver
programme.desc: Hal-hal aneh mulai terjadi setelah sekelompok mahasiswa kedokteran membedah mayat.

programme.title: Cafe Midnight
programme.desc: Yoon pergi mencari pengantin prianya, Taeyoung, yang tidak muncul di hari pernikahan. Secara kebetulan, ia tiba di sebuah tempat aneh bernama 'Cafe Midnight' dan menemukan Taeyoung yang berusia muda dari masa lalu.

programme.title: Second Sister
programme.desc: Setelah adiknya bunuh diri akibat fitnah dan komentar jahat di dunia maya, So-eun bersama detektif Jun-kyung mengungkap kebenaran di balik kasus yang melibatkan akun-akun anonim.

programme.title: Office (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Penyelidikan setelah seorang manajer penjualan membunuh seluruh keluarganya secara brutal mengarah pada serangkaian misteri dan tragedi di tengah tim kerja yang kewalahan di Seoul.

programme.title: Following (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Sebuah film thriller misteri tentang seorang agen real estat yang diam-diam memasuki rumah klien dan terobsesi dengan seorang influencer media sosial yang suka menipu. Film ini mengeksplorasi tema obsesi, identitas, dan sisi gelap media sosial.

programme.title: The Noisy Mansion (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Geo-Wool pindah setelah bertengkar dengan saudara laki-lakinya, Du-On. Di apartemen barunya di Baekse, dia mendengar suara-suara misterius di lantai pada pukul 4 pagi. Karena tidak bisa tidur, dia dan tetangganya menyelidiki sumber suara tersebut.

programme.title: A Melody To Remember (tvN Movies)

programme.title: My Love, My Bride
programme.desc: Young Min dan Mi Young menikah setelah lulus kuliah. Namun, pertengkaran dan kesalahpahaman mulai menguji rumah tangga mereka. Di tengah konflik, keduanya perlahan belajar memahami arti cinta dan pernikahan.

programme.title: Project Wolf Hunting
programme.desc: Selama ekstradisi ke Korea, sekelompok penjahat nan berbahaya berkumpul untuk melarikan diri dari sebuah penjara terapung.

programme.title: Heartman: Rock And Love
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang ayah tunggal yang harus menyembunyikan keberadaan putrinya dari cinta pertamanya saat SMA. Mereka bertemu kembali secara tidak sengaja, tetapi ia mengetahui bahwa wanita tersebut tidak tertarik menjalin hubungan dengan pria yang sudah memiliki anak.

programme.title: Apa Kabar Indonesia Pagi

Tiba-tiba pekerja am, Sean dan Beber diangkat menjadi pengurus segera kerana mereka yang paling lama berkhidmat di Damai Beach Resort selain Kak Maggie yang sudah amnesia. Sean dan Beber mempunyai dua sikap yang berbeza namun mereka perlu bersama-sama menjadi pengurus hotel untuk menyelamatkan hotel tersebut sementara menunggu kepulangan Tuan Rudi dan mendapatkan gaji mereka yang tertunggak.

Tujuannya adalah untuk mencuri pelan keselamatan setahun bagi membolehkan organisasi M.A.D. sentiasa berada selangkah di hadapan pihak polis.

Bapanya yang telah meninggal dunia sebelum ini merupakan seorang peguam daerah yang berjaya. Berani, jujur dan bertekad untuk membuktikan kebolehannya, Gordon perlu berdepan dengan permainan politik kotor dalam sistem keadilan Gotham, selain kemunculan penjahat berbahaya.

Dibarisi pemuzik bertaraf dunia bersama visual pentas antarabangsa yang memukau, sambutan budaya bertenaga tinggi ini bakal menyatukan peminat muzik merentasi pelbagai generasi.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: No Blueberry Is an Island
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does, so they can prepare accordingly—they see Strawberry wearing a diving mask and snorkel in the cafe, and race to the lake to practice scuba diving, not knowing she was only slicing onions.

programme.title: Where the Berry Breeze Blows
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here! She insists they can build a copy of “Berry Breezy Bay” resort on Berry Bitty Lake, a duplicate down to the last detail.

programme.title: Sid's Rainy Day Play Date

programme.title: Special Sunny Dad Day

programme.title: Tarzan and Jane
programme.desc: Tarzan, rescued by Kala and given supernatural powers, defends the jungle from threats. Discovered by his grandfather's expedition, he meets Jane and returns to London. There, they uncover a plot to steal exotic animals, leading Tarzan and Jane to thwart the villains and save the animals.

programme.title: Blippi's Spooky Spell Halloween
programme.desc: With a guidebook of Spooky Halloween Spells, Blippi investigates costumes, treats, and the art of pumpkin carving.

programme.title: The Berry Best Vacation
programme.desc: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top “Entertainment Tonight”-style show host/producer from Episode 206. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation. Trying to accommodate Mavis and continue their vacation doesn't work—every time the girls try to have fun together, Mavis pops up, poking a microphone in Cherry's face, insisting on treating her as if she were a Lady Gaga-type.

programme.title: The Berry Long Winter
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City—a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play “Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose.” The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing. But it turns out the Berrykins' version of the game has different rules: they zoom around on little hang gliders made of leaves!

programme.title: Contact

programme.title: Pain and Gain
programme.desc: Go Onizuka, a popular duelist on Link VRAINS, accepts an offer from SOL to duel Playmaker. He wants to prove himself and he sees Playmaker as a powerful opponent. He lures Yusaku into a trap and a Speed Duel begins.

programme.title: The Big Freeze
programme.desc: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors—the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. “We don't know when the next mail will get through!” It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting! She gets a brainstorm. Cutting up the side of an old broken tennis racket, she attaches the pieces to her rain boots—instant ice skates! Fashionably bundled against the cold, and pulled by butterflies who sail on the wind like kites, she sail-skates down the frozen road, to the amazement of her friends.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programme.desc: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: Only One Can Remain
programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.” On the island, Lloyd learns his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen. They meet the playfully deceitful ruler who tells them they are in a tournament where ‘Only one can remain'. When they are spoiled by their posh quarters, they are surprised to find the game is already afoot: Last person to find a Jade Blade is out. After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.
